mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, customer_id, delta, reason_code, source_type, source_ref, operator_user_id, created_at FROM crm_points_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(delta), 0) FROM crm_points_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_points_ledger (tenant_id, customer_id, delta, reason_code, source_type, source_ref, operator_user_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{delta}, #{reasonCode}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, #{operatorUserId})
